headline: Carrier Global (NYSE:CARR) Surprises With Strong Q2 CY2026, Guides for Strong Full-Year Sales
summary: Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration company Carrier Global (NYSE:CARR) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 3.9% year on year to $6.35 billion.
